introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Further Mathematics Paper 2 (0775), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2023. Time allowed: three hours.**

Answer ALL 10 questions. For your guidance, the approximate mark allocation for parts of each question is indicated. Mathematical formulae and tables published by the Board, and noiseless non-programmable electronic calculators are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage.

questions.corrige_markdown:
Let $y = \tanh^{-1}4x$, which is defined for $|4x| < 1$, i.e. $|x| < \tfrac14$. Then $\tanh y = 4x$. Using the exponential definition of $\tanh$:
$$\tanh y = \frac{e^{y} - e^{-y}}{e^{y} + e^{-y}} = \frac{e^{2y} - 1}{e^{2y} + 1} = 4x.$$
Solve for $e^{2y}$:
$$e^{2y} - 1 = 4x\,e^{2y} + 4x \quad\Rightarrow\quad e^{2y}(1 - 4x) = 1 + 4x \quad\Rightarrow\quad e^{2y} = \frac{1 + 4x}{1 - 4x}.$$
Since $|x| < \tfrac14$, both $1 + 4x$ and $1 - 4x$ are positive, so the quotient is positive and we may take logarithms:
$$2y = \ln\left(\frac{1 + 4x}{1 - 4x}\right) \quad\Rightarrow\quad \tanh^{-1}4x = \tfrac12\ln\left(\frac{1 + 4x}{1 - 4x}\right). \qquad\blacksquare$$

questions.enonce_markdown: Hence, or otherwise, solve the equation $\tanh^{-1}4x - \ln 2 = 0$. (3 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
By part (a), the equation becomes
$$\tfrac12\ln\left(\frac{1 + 4x}{1 - 4x}\right) = \ln 2 \quad\Rightarrow\quad \ln\left(\frac{1 + 4x}{1 - 4x}\right) = 2\ln 2 = \ln 4 \quad\Rightarrow\quad \frac{1 + 4x}{1 - 4x} = 4.$$
Then $1 + 4x = 4 - 16x$, so $20x = 3$ and
$$\boxed{x = \frac{3}{20}}.$$
This satisfies $|x| < \tfrac14$ because $\tfrac{3}{20} = 0.15 < 0.25$, so it is a valid solution.

(Check by another route: $4x = \tanh(\ln 2) = \dfrac{2 - \tfrac12}{2 + \tfrac12} = \dfrac35$, so $x = \dfrac{3}{20}$.)
